title.justification: The paper title is stated at the beginning.
title.value: Neural Causal Structure Discovery from Interventions

extractions.description: Introduces and empirically evaluates sdi, a neural-network-based causal-structure-discovery method trained with observational and interventional data, including unknown-intervention and partial-graph settings.

type.quote: We evaluate our proposed approach in the context of graph recovery, both de novo and from a partially-known edge set.
type.justification: The paper reports experiments, benchmark comparisons, ablations, and numerical graph-recovery results.

name.quote: We introduce a novel neural network-based method for causal discovery called Structure Discovery from Interventions (sdi).
name.justification: The main contribution is a new causal-discovery method.

name.quote: Structure discovery concerns itself with the recovery of the graph structure of Bayesian networks from data.
name.justification: The work advances learning the structure of Bayesian networks.

name.quote: Our proposed method Structure Discovery from Interventions (sdi) is among the first causal discovery methods based on neural networks that utilize both observational and interventional data.
name.justification: The work contributes a neural/continuous-optimization approach within machine learning.

name.quote: An example is protein structure learning in biology, where we may have definite knowledge about some parts of the protein-protein interaction structure but need to fill out other parts
name.justification: Biology is used as an application example rather than directly advanced by the experiments.

name.quote: The proposed model, sdi, is a neural-network-based approach for causal discovery that integrates both observational and interventional data.
name.justification: The paper explicitly calls sdi its proposed model and trains its functional and structural parameters.

is_contributed.quote: We introduce a novel neural network-based method for causal discovery called Structure Discovery from Interventions (sdi).
is_contributed.justification: sdi is introduced as the paper's novel contribution.

is_compared.quote: We compare sdi against a range of state-of-the-art methods
